impact.text: A malicious user can drain a large amount of the market underlying collateral in a single block, front-running all other users.

precondition_sources.text: The total supply of one of the market's synthetic tokens (aToken or zToken) is zero.
The attacker holds the entire remaining supply of the other synthetic token.

intent_sources.text: The full-redeem cap-bypass path should only be reachable when the user is redeeming the full supply of both aToken and zToken, preventing the 0 == 0 loophole.
